title: Signature Beds
descriptionHtml:
Eagle Bed Signature Designs

A selection of our signature designs in one place: Mayfair, wingback, ottoman storage, Chesterfield and panel beds. Every bed is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire on a solid wood frame and upholstered in your choice of fabric.

How to choose from this selection

Pick the headboard style

  • Mayfair — our Mayfair designs are offered as bed frames, bumper beds and ottoman divan beds. See all upholstered beds.
  • Wingback — tall upholstered headboards with side wings. See wingback beds.
  • Chesterfield — deep-buttoned headboards. See Chesterfield beds.
  • Panel — padded vertical, fan and channel panels. See panel beds.

Decide on storage

Ottoman gas-lift beds lift the whole base for large under-bed storage, while drawer beds keep the mattress fixed. Compare ottoman beds and storage beds with drawers.

Sizes and fabrics

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT), upholstered to order in fabrics including Plush Velvet, Chenille and Teddy Bouclé. Add a matching mattress to complete the set.

Frequently asked questions

What does this collection contain?

A selection of our signature designs across several styles. Each product page shows its own sizes, fabrics and options.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery across Great Britain is free (Northern Ireland £90) and made by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man is £90.

What warranty do I get?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty. See our warranty page for the full terms.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. We post free fabric swatches so you can check colour and texture in your own light. Request free swatches.

Can I pay in instalments?

Klarna and Clearpay are available. See our finance options.

Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire · solid wood frames · free delivery across Great Britain (Northern Ireland £90) by our own team, usually in 3–5 working days · 5-year warranty · free fabric swatches · Klarna and Clearpay available. Questions? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
